vorher_gesamt.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS anzahl, MAX(id) AS letzte_id, SUM(kosten_eur) AS kosten_eur FROM kasse

laeufe.sql: SELECT lauf_id,COUNT(*) AS anzahl,SUM(kosten_eur) AS kosten_eur FROM kasse WHERE lauf_id BETWEEN 22 AND 25 GROUP BY lauf_id

etappen22.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN id<=3411 THEN 'erste_etappe' ELSE 'fortsetzung' END AS abschnitt,COUNT(*) AS anzahl,SUM(kosten_eur) AS kosten_eur,MIN(id) AS erste_id,MAX(id) AS letzte_id,MIN(zeit) AS beginn,MAX(zeit) AS ende FROM kasse WHERE lauf_id=22 GROUP BY 1

grenzzeilen.sql: SELECT id,lauf_id,zeit,zweck,kosten_eur FROM kasse WHERE lauf_id=22 AND (id>=3388 AND id<=3652)

rohbestand.sql: SELECT id,lauf_id,zeit,zweck,kosten_eur FROM kasse WHERE lauf_id BETWEEN 22 AND 25 ORDER BY id
